name: Cilium External Connectivity Review
summary: Decide whether traffic crossing the cluster boundary through BGP Control Plane advertisement, LB-IPAM, L2 announcements, the egress gateway or ClusterMesh is reachable, correctly owned, bounded and failure-isolated as claimed. Separates control-plane state from datapath reachability and checks documented incompatibilities and failure behavior. Static review: never changes BGP, pools, announcements, gateways or mesh configuration.
security_notes: Static review only. No live guard covers BGP, LB-IPAM or L2 announcement resources, so every change there is a proposal for the human change process. A ClusterMesh is one trust domain; never request BGP auth Secrets, mesh certificates or kvstore credentials.
